cohort: The study included 42,627 singleton pregnancies from Geisinger, excluding those with pregravid BMI <18 kg/m2, gestational age <34 weeks, pregestational diabetes, chronic hypertension, prior cesarean delivery, or contraindication to vaginal delivery.
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain (EGWG) poses a greater risk than gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, severe HDP, cesarean delivery, large for gestational age, and shoulder dystocia, regardless of pregravid BMI.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery generally increased from patients with no GDM/no EGWG to those with GDM/no EGWG to those with no GDM/EGWG to those with GDM/EGWG, with EGWG posing a greater risk for CD than GDM.
gest_age: Pregnancies with gestational age <34 weeks were excluded, and NICU admission was evaluated for those at >=35 weeks.
